            </div>
            <p class="takeaway-source reveal">Source: 2024 Stack Overflow Developer Survey · survey.stackoverflow.co/2024/work · 65,437 respondents across 180+ countries</p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.updateUI(0);
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateUI(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateUI(idx) {
                // Progress bar
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
                // Counter
                document.getElementById('slideCounter').textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${this.total}`;
                // Dots
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0, startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                        else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.updateUI(0);
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateUI(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateUI(idx) {
                // Progress bar
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
                // Counter
                document.getElementById('slideCounter').textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${this.total}`;
                // Dots
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0, startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                        else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Developer Workforce & Compensation Trends — 2024 Stack Overflow Survey</title>

    <!-- Swiss Modern: Archivo + Nunito from Google Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=Nunito:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* === CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (SWISS MODERN THEME) === */
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #ffffff;
            --bg-dark: #0f0f0f;
            --bg-mid: #f5f5f5;
            --text-dark: #0f0f0f;
            --text-light: #ffffff;
            --text-muted: #666666;
            --accent-red: #ff3300;
            --accent-red-dim: rgba(255,51,0,0.12);
            --border: #0f0f0f;

            --font-display: 'Archivo', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Nunito', sans-serif;

            /* Typography — all clamp() */
            --title-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.4vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.72rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.55s;
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* === VIEWPORT BASE CSS (mandatory) === */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* === BASE TYPOGRAPHY === */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            opacity: 0.2;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1.4);
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* === SLIDE COUNTER === */
        .slide-counter {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            z-index: 1000;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        /* === ANIMATIONS === */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* === SLIDE NUMBER LABEL === */
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-red);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        /* === GEOMETRIC ACCENT ELEMENTS (Swiss Modern) === */
        .geo-line {
            position: absolute;
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .geo-dot {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .geo-circle {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           ============================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-title .title-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-title .top-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .slide-title .brand-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .slide-title .year-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        }
        .slide-title .main-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .slide-title h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.0;
            color: var(--text-light);
            max-width: 80%;
        }
        .slide-title h1 em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .slide-title .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 300;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }
        .slide-title .stat-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            margin-top: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);
        }
        .slide-title .stat-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2rem;
        }
        .slide-title .stat-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-title .stat-desc {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .slide-title .bottom-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .slide-title .source-credit {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }
        /* Red accent stripe left */
        .slide-title::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
            width: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 2: EMPLOYMENT STATUS
           ============================================== */
        .slide-employment {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-employment .layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-employment .slide-header {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }
        .slide-employment h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }
        .slide-employment h2 em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .emp-panel {
            background: var(--bg-mid);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .emp-panel h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            flex: 1;
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(80px, 15vw, 140px) 1fr clamp(30px, 5vw, 55px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bar-track {
            height: clamp(12px, 2vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
            border-radius: 1px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border-radius: 1px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .bar-fill.accent { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .bar-fill.muted { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }
        .slide.visible .bar-fill { width: var(--bar-w); }

        /* US vs Global callout */
        .us-callout {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .us-callout .callout-title {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .us-compare {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .us-compare .yr {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.2rem;
        }
        .us-compare .big-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .us-compare .yr-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
        }
        .us-compare .arrow {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .us-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 3: WORK ENVIRONMENT
           ============================================== */
        .slide-work {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-work .layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-work h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }
        .slide-work h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-red); }
        .work-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .trend-panel {
            background: var(--bg-mid);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .trend-panel h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .year-bars {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem);
            flex: 1;
        }
        .year-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(30px, 5vw, 45px) 1fr clamp(30px, 5vw, 48px);
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .year-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .donut-section {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .donut-wrap {
            position: relative;
            width: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px);
            height: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .donut-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); }
        .donut-label {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .donut-label .big { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--h3-size); font-weight: 900; }
        .donut-label .sm { font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-muted); }
        .legend-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            width: 100%;
        }
        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }
        .legend-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .inperson-callout {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            color: #fff;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }
        .inperson-callout .callout-big {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .inperson-callout .callout-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 4: SALARY BY DEVELOPER TYPE (figure_1)
           ============================================== */
        .slide-salary-role {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-salary-role .layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-salary-role h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-salary-role h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-red); }
        .salary-chart-wrap {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .hbar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .hbar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(90px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(45px, 7vw, 80px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
        }
        .hbar-role {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .hbar-track {
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vh, 18px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: 1px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            border-radius: 1px;
        }
        .hbar-fill.top { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .hbar-salary {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
        }
        .slide.visible .hbar-fill { width: var(--bar-w); }
        .salary-figure-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .salary-figure-panel img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(42vh, 350px);
            object-fit: contain;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .salary-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 5: EXPERIENCE VS SALARY SCATTER
           ============================================== */
        .slide-scatter {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-scatter .layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-scatter h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }
        .slide-scatter h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-red); }
        .scatter-wrap {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .scatter-figure {
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }
        .scatter-figure img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(44vh, 370px);
            object-fit: contain;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .scatter-insights {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .insight-card {
            background: var(--bg-mid);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-red);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3rem;
        }
        .insight-card .ic-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 900;
        }
        .insight-card .ic-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .insight-card.dark {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
            border-color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .insight-card.dark .ic-label { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

        /* ==============================================
           SLIDE 6: SALARY BY LANGUAGE
           ============================================== */
        .slide-lang {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-lang .layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: 100%;
        }
        .slide-lang h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .slide-lang h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-red); }
        .lang-wrap {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .lang-figure {
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .lang-figure img {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(44vh, 360px);
            object-fit: contain;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .lang-data {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .lang-section-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        .lang-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(60px, 9vw, 90px) 1fr clamp(50px, 8vw, 75px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
        }
        .lang-name {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
        }
        .lang-bar-track {
            height: clamp(8px, 1.5vh, 14px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: 1px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .lang-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 0%;
            border-radius: 1px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .lang-bar-fill.high { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .lang-bar-fill.low { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .lang-salary {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .slide.visible .lang-bar-fill { width: var(--bar-w); }
        .lang-divider {
            height: 1px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            margin: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem) 0;
        }
        .salary-drop-note {
            background: rgba(255,51,0,0.15);

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.updateUI(0);
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateUI(idx);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateUI(idx) {
                // Progress bar
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
                // Counter
                document.getElementById('slideCounter').textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${this.total}`;
                // Dots
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0, startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                        else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.total - 1));
                    else this.goTo(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
